thread:
sarah: Quick sync — cross-env compatibility check for /v2 endpoints. Where are we on canary coverage and SDK bumps?

diego: Canary's live in eu-west for text-gen. Saw a spike of 429s around 50 rps, digging into batching.

priya: I pushed an SDK patch that tolerates 204 vs 200 for embeddings. PR #4123. Need @ryan review.

ryan: On it, will review by EOD. Also confirm: x-client-version header is required for routing, right?

sarah: Yes — x-client-version required. We're gating the /v1 deprecation next week. Milestone: freeze client-facing changelog by Thu.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: v2-canary-1779990001 -> eu-west-1 subset

diego: Logs snippet: ```ERROR: 429 throttle at tokenizer::batch() host=worker-12``` Throttle seems to stem from batch_size. Reducing batch_size->4 improved p50.

priya: Good catch. Runtime has a batch_size hint override via route config — I'll add a note to the canary docs and a temporary override for eu-west.

ryan: Quick schema question: if we fallback to legacy model (small-legacy) on overload, do we keep response schema identical? SDK expects {choices, meta}. Need explicit mapping.

sarah: We should keep v2 schema. Priya, please add a transformation layer in the router to map legacy responses -> v2_schema. Owner: priya for shim, diego for telemetry.

priya: Assigned. I'll open a router-shim PR + unit tests. ETA: tomorrow morning.

diego: I'll add telemetry tag 'shim-fallback' and include sample query ids so we can track incidence and latency.

sarah: Dependency: eng-infra needs to finish header-propagation toggle (INFRA-789). Diego/Ryan, do you need anything else from infra?

ryan: We need a small config toggle in the proxy to passthrough client headers. Pinged infra in #eng-infra — can we escalate?

diego: Escalating to infra via @matt. Also adding a simple smoke test: `curl -H "x-client-version:2" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/health` should return 200 + header echo.

matt: matt: Saw the ping. I can add the toggle today, target deploy 18:00 UTC. Will post PR link shortly.

sarah: Risk note: deprecating /v1 without SDK rollout will break legacy clients. I'll send the final deprecation email once changelog is frozen.

priya: We should add a migration snippet to SDK docs showing header addition and schema mapping. I'll draft and share in #docs.

ryan: Reviewers for the PRs: @sarah, @diego, @matt. I'll queue my review after infra PR lands.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary health check: 95% success, 4% shim-fallback, 1% error. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/1779990001

sarah: :thumbsup: Next milestones: freeze changelog Thu, SDK RC Fri, full cutover Mon — I'll update the project board.

diego: Action items recap: 1) throttle mitigation (in progress) 2) telemetry tags (in progress) 3) infra toggle (PR pending) 4) router shim PR (priya).

priya: I'll post PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4180

ryan: I'll review #4180 and SDK patch #4123. If no blockers, approve by EOD.

sarah: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping #eng-oncall. Closing this thread for async updates — post follow-ups as threads under the PRs.
